question: Should this protected PR be closed as superseded by the guarded implementation on current main, or should the contributor refresh it onto that implementation with real behavior proof?
rationale: Automation cannot close a maintainer-protected PR, and the remaining choice is maintainer ownership of a stale branch versus asking for a refreshed contributor path.

options.title: Close as Superseded
options.body: Close this PR because current main and v2026.6.11 already contain the safer guarded cache and invalidation tests.

options.title: Refresh and Reprove
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase onto current main, preserve the guarded cacheability semantics, and add redacted runtime or profiler proof.

options.title: Override Proof Gap
options.body: A maintainer may accept source-level evidence only, but should explicitly record why real gateway/profiler proof is not required.

recommendation.title: Close as Superseded
recommendation.body: Close this PR because current main and v2026.6.11 already contain the safer guarded cache and invalidation tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle authored the guarded cache implementation now present on current main and in the latest release.
